normative_requirements.title: Semantic and Realization Distinction
normative_requirements.text: An ADR-derived application's semantic definition shall remain distinguishable from any concrete realization used to package, deliver, discover, bind, or operate that application.

normative_requirements.title: Initialization Determinacy
normative_requirements.text: A realization intended to initialize an Agent without prior application-specific conversational context shall provide or resolve enough information to determine the application, selected application instance, applicable Ruleset authority where consequential, and relevant authoritative Dataset state.

normative_requirements.title: Application Identity
normative_requirements.text: Initialization shall establish which ADR-derived application semantics govern the reasoning operation.

normative_requirements.title: Instance Identity
normative_requirements.text: Initialization of an independently continuing application instance shall establish which application instance's Dataset authority is selected for the reasoning operation.

normative_requirements.title: Applicable Ruleset at Initialization
normative_requirements.text: When multiple distinguishable Ruleset states may coexist, initialization shall preserve enough identity or traceability to determine the applicable governing Ruleset for the selected operation.

normative_requirements.title: Dataset Authority at Initialization
normative_requirements.text: Committed application state available during initialization shall be interpreted from the selected application instance's authoritative Dataset rather than from transient Agent or conversational memory.

normative_requirements.title: Initialization Is Not Implicit Mutation
normative_requirements.text: Loading, attaching, selecting, discovering, or binding an application realization shall not by itself create a committed Dataset transition unless the derived application's own Ruleset-governed transition semantics explicitly define and accept such a transition.

normative_requirements.title: Missing Governance Is Not Permission
normative_requirements.text: When governing Ruleset semantics required for initialization or operation are missing or indeterminate, the Agent shall not invent application meaning or treat that absence as permission to mutate committed Dataset state.

normative_requirements.title: Read-Only Reasoning Permitted
normative_requirements.text: After initialization, an Agent may inspect, summarize, explain, or otherwise reason about application state without creating a Dataset transition when the applicable application semantics classify the operation as non-mutating.

normative_requirements.title: Transition Contract Preserved
normative_requirements.text: A state-changing operation after initialization shall become committed Dataset state only through the derived application's applicable Ruleset-governed transition acceptance semantics.

normative_requirements.title: Self-Contained Realization Permitted
normative_requirements.text: A realization may physically co-locate application identity, Ruleset material, Dataset state, initialization material, and realization metadata while preserving their ADR semantic roles and authority boundaries.

normative_requirements.title: Managed Realization Permitted
normative_requirements.text: A realization may obtain shared Ruleset authority separately from independently stored Dataset instances when initialization preserves applicable Ruleset determinacy and Dataset-instance authority.

normative_requirements.title: Provider and Packaging Independence
normative_requirements.text: FS-003 conformance shall not require a particular Agent provider, bootstrap prompt, file format, serialization, file count, repository, transport, storage service, or application-builder technology.

normative_requirements.title: Cross-Realization Semantic Preservation
normative_requirements.text: When the same ADR-derived application is realized for multiple providers or packaging environments, each claimed semantically compatible realization shall preserve the Ruleset, Dataset, instance, authority, and transition meaning required by the operations it supports.

normative_requirements.title: Seed-Spec Artifact Realization
normative_requirements.text: Build shall realize the accepted FS-003 contract as one distributable seed-spec artifact derived from canonical Product Design, Planning, and normative specification state.

normative_requirements.title: Seed-Spec Artifact Fidelity
normative_requirements.text: The FS-003 seed-spec artifact shall preserve the complete active FS-003 normative contract without inventing, weakening, extending, or silently replacing canonical ADR meaning.

normative_requirements.title: Seed-Spec Artifact Identity and Traceability
normative_requirements.text: The FS-003 seed-spec artifact shall identify ADR as Agent · Dataset · Ruleset, identify itself as derived from FS-003, and record the exact FS-003 Design revision `3c901f08c1014fcbc014f45aedb3a485f791a9f8`.

normative_requirements.title: Builder and Generated Artifact Non-Authority
normative_requirements.text: Application-builder tooling and generated application realizations shall not be treated as independent ADR normative authority merely because they consume or implement ADR semantics.
